artifacts.summary: Confirms the three grounding defects lack a fitting existing defect_class, proposes the minimum new-class set (SESSION_LOCK_CONTENTION, HOOK_REGEX_BOUNDARY_DEFECT, DEPLOY_ORPHAN_DRIFT), and gives exact edit locations in system-defect-record.sh and system-defect-discrimination.md.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase, a closed enum's canonical enumeration and its bash-validated definition are frequently split across exactly two files: a context/patterns/*.md table (the human-readable, decision-recording source) and a scripts/*.sh case statement (the machine-validated mirror). When asked to extend a vocabulary, grep the whole source store for every existing enum literal (not just the two obvious files) to find all consumers before concluding the edit surface is small -- confirmed here that neither of the two SKILL.md consumer files needed changes because they only produce hardcoded literals, never switch generically over the enum.

system-defect-discrimination.md documents a deliberate precedent: a new Signal A vocabulary instance may be added to the table before any detector calls system-defect-record.sh for it (see the existing ARTIFACTS_MISSING_ON_SUCCESS row, marked 'not currently computed anywhere'). Naming a defect class and wiring a detector/recorder call are treated as separate, sequential pieces of work, not one atomic change -- useful precedent when a task's scope is explicitly limited to vocabulary naming.
